description: List and read GitLab projects, issues, merge requests, notes, branches, commits, files and CI/CD pipelines and jobs, and create, update and merge issues and merge requests, on gitlab.com or your self-hosted instance in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in GitLab session.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects accessible to the authenticated user. Can filter by membership, visibility, search query, and more.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific project by its path (e.g., "group/project").

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search for projects by name across GitLab.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues for a project. By default returns opened issues sorted by creation date. Can filter by state, labels, assignee, milestone, and more.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific issue.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a project.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing issue. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: list_merge_requests
tools.description: List merge requests for a project. By default returns opened MRs sorted by creation date. Can filter by state, labels, author, assignee, and more.

tools.name: get_merge_request
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific merge request.

tools.name: create_merge_request
tools.description: Create a new merge request in a project.

tools.name: update_merge_request
tools.description: Update an existing merge request. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: merge_merge_request
tools.description: Accept and merge a merge request. Optionally squash commits or delete the source branch.

tools.name: get_merge_request_diff
tools.description: Get the diff changes of a merge request. Returns per-file diffs.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes (comments) on an issue or merge request. System notes (status changes, label updates) are included by default.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Add a comment (note) to an issue or merge request.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List branches for a project. Can filter by search query.

tools.name: get_file_content
tools.description: Read a file from a repository. Returns the decoded content as text. Use the ref parameter to read from a specific branch or commit.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List commits for a project. Can filter by branch, path, and date range.

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: List CI/CD pipelines for a project. Can filter by status, ref, and source.

tools.name: list_pipeline_jobs
tools.description: List jobs for a specific pipeline.

tools.name: get_job_log
tools.description: Get the log (trace) output of a CI/CD job. Returns the raw log text.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a user profile by username. Defaults to the authenticated user if no username is specified.
